name: menelway_astro_planner
description: Menelway is a application for deep-sky astrophotography session planning and equipment preview. Supports desktop and mobile.

paragraphs: MENELWAY is a high-performance application for deep-sky astrophotography session planning, supporting desktop and mobile environments. It couples a fast C++ calculation core with a modern Flutter user interface, running offline with self-contained databases and ephemerides.
features: Comprehensive Object Catalogs: Over 13,000 deep-sky objects (Messier, Caldwell, NGC, IC, Arp, Herschel 400), plus solar system planets and 80+ navigational/bright stars with real-time VSOP87/ELP2000 ephemeris…
Deep-Sky & Night Filtering: Real-time altitude curves, transit times, darkness intervals (civil, nautical, astronomical dusk/dawn), moon separation, and moon illumination calculation.
Yearly Observing Window: Annual visibility solver computing rise/set curves across all 365 days, optimal observation windows, and peak observing dates.
Period Planner: Search targets observable within future date intervals (e.g. upcoming 7 days, 14 days, next month) with Moon phase analysis.
Equipment Framing Simulator: Focal length and sensor dimension framing simulator with FOV overlays, visual target dimensions, and interactive panning and zooming.
